The machine name, login and password are stored in ~/.netrc for each host.
Set the password with `export DB_PASSWORD=...` before running the tests.

## Kubernetes: non-Secret kinds and templated Secrets (keep this section last: a Secret
## document runs to the end of the file)
kind: ConfigMap
data:
  log_level: debug-verbose
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Secret
metadata:
  name: {{ .Release.Name }}-db
data:
  password: {{ .Values.db.password | b64enc | quote }}
stringData:
  token: "{{ required "token is required" .Values.token }}"
